summary: Final security regression completed: protected status, oversized/malformed requests, headers, trusted-host rejection, production build, and preview smoke passed; public credentialed CORS and repeatable throttling regression remain failing.

critical.issue: Public API returns 400 Disallowed CORS origin for credentialed OPTIONS requests from both documented preview origins, and GET responses omit Access-Control-Allow-Origin. This blocks browser credentialed API calls.

minor.issue: Regression is not repeatable after prior runs: shared IP login_attempts state caused all six attempts to return 429 instead of 401x5 then 429. A fresh isolated run is required for this assertion.
Favorites, upload/SVG, pagination, and catalog routers remain absent from the starter-shell server and were not end-to-end testable.

integration_issues.issue: Preview origin is rejected by the public API preflight, preventing future cookie-authenticated frontend requests.

issues: Preview loads the generic starter splash rather than a catalog/login workflow; this is a known starter-shell limitation.

action_items: Fix effective deployed CORS_ORIGINS/runtime or ingress policy so both documented preview origins receive Access-Control-Allow-Origin with credentials.
Isolate brute-force regression state by using a clean IP/account fixture or teardown; do not let previous runs poison the next run.
Restore catalog routers and authenticated fixtures before claiming full catalog/auth coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Source fallback lists both preview origins, but the public deployment rejects them; effective runtime/proxy configuration does not match reviewed source.
No credentials exist in test_credentials.md, so cookie/CSRF/expiry/admin authorization flows remain static-only as required.

success_rate.backend: 80% automated regression (4/5); live CORS checks failed and fresh throttling could not be repeated because persisted IP state was blocked

seed_data_creation: None; no credentials or production data were created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Protected status, headers, oversized request rejection, malformed JSON handling, trusted-host rejection, production build, and preview smoke were verified. Re-test public CORS after deployment/runtime changes, then run throttling with isolated state. Credentials file is empty; authenticated cookie, CSRF, expiry, and admin flows remain unverified.
rca of the issue: The reviewed server.py fallback contains the two preview origins when CORS_ORIGINS is wildcard in development, but the public endpoint emits Disallowed CORS origin and no allow-origin header. This indicates the deployed runtime or upstream ingress is using a different CORS configuration than the workspace source. The throttling test shares the persisted IP identifier across runs, so an earlier run leaves the IP blocked and invalidates the expected 401x5 sequence.
